# Contributing to Photo Club Hub Data

Help is welcome. The guide for all four Photo Club Hub repositories is
[CONTRIBUTING.md in the Photo-Club-Hub repository](https://github.com/vdhamer/Photo-Club-Hub/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md):
where to start, help that needs no code, and what a pull request needs.

What differs in this repository:

- Starter issues: [good first issue](https://github.com/vdhamer/Photo-Club-Hub-Data/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3A%22Good+first+issue%22)
  and [help wanted](https://github.com/vdhamer/Photo-Club-Hub-Data/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3A%22Help+wanted%22).
- It is a Swift package, not an app. Open its folder in Xcode, choose *My Mac* as the run destination,
  and run the tests with ⌘U. See [Testing](../README.md#testing) for more.
- The two apps use a tagged release of this package, so a change here reaches them only after a new version
  is tagged. The maintainer does the tagging; see [Versioning](../README.md#versioning).
